usage: The word '刷牙' (caat3 ngaa4) is commonly used as a verb phrase meaning 'to brush teeth'.
It is usually placed after a subject and before objects or complements in a sentence.
You can use it in various tenses by adding time words or particles, e.g., '我早晨刷牙' (I brush my teeth in the morning).
It can be used in commands or requests, e.g., '記得刷牙' (Remember to brush your teeth).
In daily life routines, it often appears in conversations about morning or night habits.
